estimand: Among full-scope typed proposers, the validation-selected architecture's confirmatory proposal quality, exact-action equivalence, and runtime cost under the frozen downstream particle system.

arms.implementation_contract: Emits normalized scores for every frozen branch/revise/retract/reactivate/rejuvenate/preserve_unresolved operation and every H,R,I,C,Z typed field.
Uses typed latent slots while retaining the identical proposal support, structured factors, and unresolved-mass output surface.
Autoregressively emits all typed particle fields with an exact joint log-probability and the complete frozen proposal-operation support.
Diagnostic structured non-neural control with the same candidate support, information view, and budget; it cannot be selected as the neural architecture.

information_contract: All arms receive the same observation, action, ontology, typed-state, and causal-history view per unit; no arm may read latent truth before action selection.
budget_contract: All arms receive the same candidate count, parameter-search count, accelerator allowance, wall-clock accounting rule, and downstream particle budget per unit.
claim_boundary: Resolves only neural_proposer_architecture after a fresh independently verified run; it cannot resolve another method binding, validate Gate B, or authorize a seven-operator ablation.
